title: OpenAI Reportedly Raises $11B at a $1.25 Trillion Valuation
dek: The full round may reach about $20B, short of an earlier $30B goal.
caption:
OpenAI is now reportedly worth $1.25 trillion, but investors aren't writing the checks it hoped for. 💰

According to Bloomberg, the ChatGPT maker has locked in $11 billion so far in a new funding round. The full raise could land near $20 billion, about a third below the $30 billion target reported earlier this fall. OpenAI hasn't confirmed the numbers, and the round is expected to close in the coming weeks.

The valuation would still make OpenAI the most valuable private company on record, up from $852 billion after its March raise, and it sets a high bar for a possible IPO next year. Meanwhile, Anthropic's IPO buyers are reportedly eyeing a valuation as low as $1.1 trillion, down from roughly $2 trillion.

Our read at AI Parabellum: trillion-dollar price tags are holding, but the money behind top AI labs is getting more cautious.
